verdicts.claim: "Their anthem has now spent 37 days as the most-streamed song on Earth — back on top in August." (desktop) / "“Dai Dai” spent 37 days as the most-streamed song on Earth — back on top in August." (mobile)
verdicts.evidence: The figure is right and the wording is already the dated, closed form the repo chose on 9 Sep. Body: Spotify's public charts endpoint (https://charts-spotify-com-service.spotify.com/public/v0/charts, read 16 Sep 2026) serves "Weekly Top Songs: Global" dated 2026-09-10 with "Dai Dai — Shakira, Burna Boy" at No. 7 (previous 6, MOVED_DOWN); the daily chart returns 401 anonymously, so no new No. 1 days can have accrued and 37 stands, matching app/data/daiDai.ts line 153 (DAI_DAI_SPOTIFY_NO1_DAYS = 37), line 156 (LAST_DAY 2026-08-22) and line 185 (RUN_ENDED = true). Wording: tests/liveClaims.test.ts defines the site's own rule — writesRunAsCurrent(line) = ONGOING || (AT_NO1_NOW && !DATED), where DATED is any month name or year (lines 115–126) — and its control test at line 344 explicitly asserts `writesRunAsCurrent("37 days as the most-streamed song on Earth — back on top in August.")` is false, i.e. "back on top in August" IS the dated fix that replaced the shipped "— and back on top." (commit 876777e1, 9 Sep 2026, #221). Both app/page.tsx line 165 and app/components/MobileHome.tsx line 316 carry that month-dated form; "in August" tells a reader the return to the top happened in August, not that it is live, and the guard runs over both files (SPOTIFY_NO1_SURFACES lines 223–227). The audit's "stale" is a relitigation of a wording decision the repo's guard already certifies; it names no figure that is wrong and no body reading that contradicts the page. The only residue is that 37 is typed rather than derived, which is a hardening preference, not a page error.
verdicts.correctedFix: No correction required. Optional hardening only: import DAI_DAI_SPOTIFY_NO1_DAYS and DAI_DAI_SPOTIFY_NO1_LAST_LONG ("./data/daiDai" in app/page.tsx, "../data/daiDai" in app/components/MobileHome.tsx) and render `${DAI_DAI_SPOTIFY_NO1_DAYS} days as the most-streamed song on Earth, the last of them on the chart dated ${DAI_DAI_SPOTIFY_NO1_LAST_LONG}`.
